actual_purpose.text: A macOS menu bar app showing a daily contemplative verse from the Diamond Sutra and Heart Sutra. Features warm paper tint, dockable/draggable placement, bilingual EN/中 toggle, favorites, date history, keyboard shortcuts, pin-to-desktop, notifications, launch-at-login, and native AppKit/SwiftUI design. SPM, no Xcode.
